marvels: THE PALACE OF THE LION'S MOUTH
remembered: THERE WAS A BUCKET, AND IT FELT LIKE A HELMET.
AND A DOG DREAMS LECTURES.
THERE WAS A GATE, AND IT WAS A CHIHUAHUA.
THERE WAS A BOWL, AND IT WAS ALWAYS ONE STEP AWAY.
THERE WAS A GATE, AND I WAS MAGNIFICENT AT IT.
THERE WAS A RAG, AND IT WAS A CROSS, AND NOBODY LOOKED.
THERE WAS A CITY, AND IT WAS ALWAYS ONE STEP AWAY.
THERE WAS A LIST, AND I WAS AT THE BOTTOM OF IT.
THERE WAS A COAT OF MAIL, AND I WAS INSIDE IT SOMEWHERE.
THERE WERE SHIPS, AND THEY WERE TALLER THAN THE CHURCH.
THERE WAS A BOWL, AND IT WAS ALWAYS EMPTY.
I WAS WEEPING VERY WELL, IN SOMEBODY ELSE'S STORY.
FIRST ZARA.
THERE WAS A SHIP, AND IT WAS SINGING.
THERE WAS A BUCKET, AND IT WAS ALWAYS ONE STEP AWAY.
THERE WERE FOUR DESTINATIONS, AND WE WENT TO A FIFTH.
THERE WAS A MESSAGE, AND IT WAS HEAVIER EACH WAY.
THERE WAS A CLOTH, AND I WATCHED IT ALL THE WAY.
THERE WERE THREE DEBTS, AND I COULD ONLY PAY ONE.
THERE WAS A LETTER, AND IT SAID WHAT I READ. THE ANSWER SAID TWO THINGS.
THERE WAS A BOARD, AND JERUSALEM WAS AT THE TOP OF IT.
THERE WAS HALF A LOAF, AND IT WAS NEVER ENOUGH.
THERE WAS A PRINCE, AND HE WAS PAYING WITH A THRONE HE DID NOT HAVE.
THERE WERE LORDS ON THEIR KNEES, AND I WAS TALLER THAN THEM FOR A MINUTE.
THERE WAS A PRINCE, AND NOBODY HAD EVER SEEN HIM.
THERE WAS A BANNER, AND A BLIND MAN WAS CARRYING IT.
THERE WAS A WINDOW, AND THE WIND TOOK WHAT SHE SAID.
THERE WAS A CITY, AND IT LET ME IN TO LOOK.
THERE WAS A CITY, AND IT WAS ON FIRE, AND I KNEW ONE STREET.
THERE WAS A THRONE, AND I WALKED OUT OF IT AT A WALK.
THERE WAS A HOLE, AND MY BROTHER WAS IN IT. HE IS NOT MY BROTHER.
NO HAND ON A WOMAN! YOU SWORE! (IN HIS OWN WORDS)
THERE WAS A DOORWAY, AND IT WAS SOMEBODY ELSE'S.
THERE WAS GOLD, AND THEN THERE WAS SILVER, AND THEN THERE WAS ME.
THERE WAS A DOG, AND HE WAS WAKING UP.
THERE WAS A STORY, AND I WAS IN IT, SMALLER THAN I THOUGHT.
THERE WAS A BOWL, AND ANY DOG COULD REACH IT.
WHO TOLD YOU THEY SAID THAT?
shards: A CITY SEEN FROM ITS WALLS
